title: Product & market research
description: Compare product demand, keywords, competitors and reviews. Define a marketplace and sample before interpreting estimates.
audience: Sellers, brands, agencies and research teams
workflow: Demand question → comparable products → keywords and reviews → validation plan
boundary: Keyword, traffic and sales estimates are not verified orders. A first-page product or review sample does not represent the whole market.

title: SEO & AI visibility
description: Check discovery, index access, product facts and referrals across Google Search and AI-assisted search.
audience: Store owners, marketers and SEO teams
workflow: Index eligibility → product facts → useful answers → referral and conversion measurement
boundary: A page-level audit does not establish sitewide indexation or guarantee rankings and AI recommendations. AI mentions, citations and visits are different outcomes.

title: Sourcing & 1688
description: Turn marketplace evidence into sourcing candidates. Compare image matches, offer details and verification requirements.
audience: Sourcing teams, private-label sellers and product developers
workflow: Product requirement → image-search candidates → offer detail → samples and verification
boundary: Image similarity and displayed offer prices do not verify an identical SKU, factory identity, compliance, landed cost or supplier reliability.

title: APIs & AI agents
description: Choose ecommerce APIs and MCP integrations by required inputs, returned fields, supported marketplaces and credit use.
audience: Developers, analysts and teams building AI agents
workflow: Required evidence → endpoint selection → bounded pilot → field validation → integration
boundary: A successful request does not establish bulk support, historical depth or every advertised field. Verify current endpoint documentation and keep API credentials private.

title: Product images & video
description: Plan product assets, compare creative workflows and inspect reference fidelity before publishing generated images or video.
audience: Creative teams, brands, agencies and ecommerce sellers
workflow: Authorized reference → production brief → model test → product-fidelity review → publish
boundary: A generated concept or one model test does not guarantee exact SKU identity, accurate labels, rights clearance or advertising performance.

title: Evidence & case studies
description: Inspect dated test inputs, observed outputs, source artifacts, credit records and the limitations of each conclusion.
audience: Anyone evaluating a workflow or checking a product claim
workflow: Read the question → inspect inputs and sources → reproduce where possible → check limitations
guide_label: Read the editorial and evidence policy
boundary: Nexscope publishes these tests about its own products. Individual observations and illustrative cases do not establish typical customer outcomes or continuous coverage.
